synthetic_data.row_count_explanation: The correct 2023-2025 calendar has 1,096 days. The file has 1,097 rows because 2023 contains one duplicated target date. The notebook groups source dates by ISO week number without ISO year; 2025 week 1 contains Jan 1-5 and Dec 29-31 (8 rows). The generator appends every sampled row but advances its target pointer by exactly 7, so selecting that block can duplicate a target date.

generation_logic.source_population: all real KPI daily totals in calendar year 2025
generation_logic.method: month-conditioned ISO-week block bootstrap with multiplicative Normal(1, 0.08) noise
generation_logic.alignment_issue: Source blocks are sorted Monday-Sunday, then assigned to consecutive target dates. When the target block does not start Monday, weekday values are cyclically misaligned; the 2023 Sunday mean is consequently generator-distorted.

leakage.reason: The notebook constructs vol_2025 from the entire year before generating 2023-2024. Therefore those rows encode the distribution and sampled blocks of Oct-Dec 2025.
leakage.promotion_mitigation: Exclude supplied synthetic rows from promotion evidence. Augmentation experiments regenerate each synthetic history from only the real prefix available before the fold.

distribution_shift.artifact_warning: Near-equal marginal mean/std are expected because synthetic values directly resample 2025. They are not independent evidence of external realism.

measured_augmentation_contribution.attribution_metric: mean D1-D7 MAE averaged across all deterministic seeds
measured_augmentation_contribution.note: Synthetic contribution is the strategy seed-mean minus the real-only seed-mean. Individual seed values are retained, but no first-seed value is used for attribution.
